label: Delaware Entity Search
title: Delaware Entity Search: Bulk Lookup & Registered Agents
metaDescription: Search the Delaware Division of Corporations by entity name or file number in bulk: formation date, entity kind and type, and registered agent.
intro: Search the Delaware Division of Corporations by entity name or file number, many at once. Each entity comes with its file number, formation date, kind and type, residency, state of formation and the registered agent's name and address.
useCases: Verify that counterparties exist and when they were formed
Find the registered agent for service of process
Check a list of company names in one run

faq.q: Is there an official Delaware entity search API?
faq.a: No. Delaware offers the entity search only as a web page. This actor runs the same search by name or file number, many at once, and returns structured rows.

faq.q: Can I find new company incorporations in Delaware?
faq.a: Each result includes the formation date, so you can search a list of names or file numbers and sort or filter by incorporation date. The registry does not publish a feed of all new filings.
Entity name, file number, formation date, entity kind and type, residency, state of formation and the registered agent.

faq.q: Can I use it as a Delaware entity search API?
faq.a: Yes. Start a run from your own code with Apify's REST API (or the JavaScript and Python clients) and read the results as JSON; the run-sync endpoint returns the items in the same HTTP call. The same input also runs in the Apify Console, on a schedule, or from Make, Zapier and n8n.

officialApi: The Delaware Division of Corporations has no public API; its entity search is a web form, and certified documents are sold through registered agents. This actor runs that public search for you in bulk.
